banking-economy.title: PNB launches special festival campaign, announces offers for retail loans
banking-economy.summary: Punjab National Bank has launched its 2026 festive retail loan campaign, offering concessions across home, car and other retail loans. Under the scheme, home loan borrowers will get a full waiver of upfront and processing fees along with a 5-basis-point rate concession, while car loans will also carry a full fee waiver.

banking-economy.title: NBFCs account for nearly half of small loans while delinquencies stay low
banking-economy.summary: Non-banking finance companies accounted for nearly half of new-to-credit loans below Rs 2 lakh as of June 2026. Their retail delinquency rate remained lower than the overall industry average, reflecting improved asset quality. Monitoring credit positively impacted borrowers' cure rates compared to those who did not monitor. The customer base for NBFCs grew significantly over the last decade, indicating increasing access to credit.
